# namespace_registry_default_policy (Resource)

Manages the singleton workspace-wide container registry image expiration and retention policy. Exclusive ownership semantics apply with last-writer-wins behavior across configurations managing the singleton workspace default policy. Destroying this resource does not restore any previous policy state; instead, it performs a neutral reset on the server by setting default_expiration = nil (disabled) and expiration_enforcement = EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_DO_NOT_ENFORCE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

# Manages workspace-wide container registry image retention policy
resource "namespace_registry_default_policy" "default" {
  default_expiration     = "720h" # 30 days
  expiration_enforcement = "EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_enforcement` (String) Image expiration enforcement mode (`EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_ENFORCE` or `EXPIRATION_ENFORCEMENT_DO_NOT_ENFORCE`).

### Optional

- `default_expiration` (String) Workspace-wide default container image expiration duration (e.g. '24h', '720h'). Must be at least 4h.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier for the default policy ('default').
- `revision` (Number) Monotonic revision number used for optimistic concurrency locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The workspace-wide default policy always uses the fixed import ID "default".
terraform import namespace_registry_default_policy.default default
```
